biography.plain_text: Alfredo Chedraui Obeso is a Mexican retailer and chairman of Grupo Comercial Chedraui. A major shareholder in the family business, he belongs to the third generation of a trading family from Xalapa. His grandparents opened a shop there, which grew through successive generations into a supermarket group operating in Mexico and the United States.

long_biography.plain_text:
Alfredo Chedraui Obeso chaired Grupo Comercial Chedraui as the retailer used stock-market finance to accelerate expansion. Following its 2010 share offering, the company enlarged its programme of store openings on both sides of the Mexico-US border. Acquisitions complemented new stores as the chain extended its reach into the American market.

In Xalapa, Chedraui also brought businesspeople together to form the founding board of Universidad Anáhuac Veracruz. The university opened in 1993, and he spent more than three decades helping develop the institution and leading its board of patrons. After Justo Fernández Chedraui became board president, the university honoured Alfredo as its founding president for life.
